contract: Road user a has completed a turn to the right. Its heading change over the window behind the observation (prim.heading_change over a window of length window, degrees, positive to the left) lies in the band from minus u_turn_min exclusive to minus turn_min inclusive: a turn to the right by at least turn_min and by less than u_turn_min, so that a heading change too small to be a turn and a reversal of direction both lie outside it. The act begins within the window behind the observation at which it is recognized. The act is recognized at the observation at which the heading change over the window behind lies in that band and a's yaw rate (kin.yaw_rate) is at most yaw_tol in magnitude, where this did not hold at the previous observation: the heading has stopped turning. The concept holds at that observation only, and not again until that condition has ceased to hold and then holds again. Conduct before the window behind is not read: a turn that takes longer than the window is not recognized. It denotes the change of a's heading only: it says nothing of the lane, the intersection or the way on which a turns, of its speed, or of why it turns. Not denoted: a heading change to the right smaller than turn_min, such as a lane change or a drift; a heading change of u_turn_min or more, which is a reversal of direction; a turn to the left; a turn still under way, whose yaw rate exceeds yaw_tol. Where the window is truncated or a yaw rate in it is missing, it is unknown.

params.name: window
params.meaning: the length of the window behind the observation over which the heading change is integrated: the longest duration of a turn

params.name: turn_min
params.meaning: the smallest heading change that is a turn

params.name: u_turn_min
params.meaning: the smallest heading change that is a reversal of direction, which bounds the band of a turn

params.name: yaw_tol
params.meaning: the yaw-rate magnitude at or below which the heading counts as no longer turning: the source's yaw-rate resolution

act.onset: The act begins within the window behind the observation at which it is recognized.
act.recognition: The act is recognized at the observation at which the heading change over the window behind lies in that band and a's yaw rate (kin.yaw_rate) is at most yaw_tol in magnitude, where this did not hold at the previous observation: the heading has stopped turning.
act.extent: The concept holds at that observation only, and not again until that condition has ceased to hold and then holds again.
act.history: Conduct before the window behind is not read: a turn that takes longer than the window is not recognized.

elements.span: Its heading change over the window behind the observation (prim.heading_change over a window of length window, degrees, positive to the left) lies in the band from minus u_turn_min exclusive to minus turn_min inclusive
elements.justification: prim.heading_change is 'the signed heading change (degrees, left positive) of a road user over the window behind the observation, integrated from kin.yaw_rate; unknown where the window is truncated, sampled too sparsely, or a yaw rate is missing'; a negative value in the band is a turn to the right.

elements.span: a's yaw rate (kin.yaw_rate) is at most yaw_tol in magnitude
elements.justification: kin.yaw_rate is the 'rate of change of heading, positive when the heading turns to the left (counter-clockwise)'; at or below the tolerance the heading has stopped turning, which marks the turn complete. It is not read as road curvature, its exclusion: it is the road user's own heading change.

scenarios.name: holds
scenarios.narrative: An electric scooter rides east, observed every second, with yaw rate zero, long enough before its turn that the window behind the judged observation lies within the recording. It then turns 90 degrees to the right over 5 s: at each of the five observations of the turn its yaw rate is -18 deg/s and its recorded heading points 18 degrees further clockwise than at the observation before, so that the heading the trace records changes exactly as the yaw rate, held over the interval before each observation, turns it; after the turn it heads south with yaw rate zero, its heading unchanged from scene to scene. At the first observation after the turn at which the yaw rate is zero, the heading change over the window behind is -90 degrees and the concept holds there.

scenarios.name: fails
scenarios.narrative: The same electric scooter turns 90 degrees to the left instead: at each of the five observations of the turn its yaw rate is +18 deg/s and its recorded heading points 18 degrees further counter-clockwise than at the observation before, matching the yaw rate held over the interval before each observation; it then heads north with yaw rate zero. At the first observation after the turn at which the yaw rate is zero, the heading change over the window behind is +90 degrees, outside the band, and the concept does not hold there.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: The right turn of the holds scenario, its recorded heading changing as in that scenario, but the source does not observe the scooter's yaw rate: at the first observation after the turn the heading change over the window behind and the yaw rate are both unobserved, and the concept is unknown there.

differs_from.why: drv.motion.u_turn denotes a reversal of direction to either hand, a heading change magnitude from u_turn_min to 360 degrees minus u_turn_min; this concept denotes a turn to the right only, a signed heading change from minus u_turn_min exclusive to minus turn_min inclusive, which excludes every reversal drv.motion.u_turn denotes and every turn to the left.
